title: Stereoselectivity: anti addition of bromine
caption: Bromine adds to cyclohexene through a bromonium ion, which bromide opens from the opposite face. Only trans-1,2-dibromocyclohexane forms, as a racemic mixture of the (R,R) and (S,S) enantiomers; the cis isomer does not form.
alt: Cyclohexene, an arrow labelled Br₂, and the two enantiomers of trans-1,2-dibromocyclohexane.
description: Products: (1R,2R)- and (1S,2S)-1,2-dibromocyclohexane, the bromines on opposite faces (trans).
